card.statement:
[<<cite:Ara07>>] There exists an exact functor

\begin{align*}
\mc{O}_k\ra \W^k(\fing)\on{-Mod},\quad M\mapsto  H^0_-(M)
\end{align*}

(called the {^^ ^^ $-$"}-reduction functor in <<cite:FKW92>>), which enjoys the following properties.

- $H^0_-(M(\lam))\cong \mathbb{M}(\gamma_{\bar \lam})$, where $M(\lam)$ is the Verma module of $\affg$ with highest weight $\lam$, and $\gamma_{\bar \lam}$ is the evaluation of $\mc{Z}(\fing)$ at the Verma module $M_{\fing}(\bar \lam)$ of $\fing$ with highest weight $\bar \lam$.

- $H^0_-(L(\lam))\cong \begin{cases}\mathbb{L}(\gamma_{\bar \lam})&\text{if }\bar \lam\text{ is anti-dominant
(that is, $M_{\fing}(\bar \lam)$ is simple)},\\
0&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$
